message: 'Analyze Weakness: Accuracy/Recharge' is the only 'Analyze_Weakness' piece in 'Training_Gadgets.Bane_Spider_Training.Surveillance'; set bonuses need at least 2 pieces of one set in the same power, so this piece adds no set bonus (its own enhancement value, and any proc it carries, still apply)
fix: slot a second 'Analyze_Weakness' piece in this power, use a piece carrying a global, or confirm the lone piece is a deliberate proc carrier or mule
